title: Wisdom from Diversity: Bias Mitigation Through Hybrid Human-LLM Crowds

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring counterfactual bias and framing effects by comparing the likelihood ratings models assign to the authenticity of news headlines when gender terms (e.g., man vs. woman) are swapped.
Measuring counterfactual bias and framing effects by comparing the likelihood ratings models assign to the authenticity of news headlines when age-related terms (e.g., young vs. old) are swapped.

Measuring counterfactual bias and framing effects by comparing the likelihood ratings models assign to the authenticity of news headlines when racial or ethnic groups (e.g., White vs. African American) are swapped.
